name: Our speakers on wall brackets above the TV (with the cables)
description: Our 2 Edifier bookshelf speakers (22 wide x 40 high x 28 deep, Mark) standing up on swivel wall arms either side of a wall-mounted TV, toed in and tilted down at the bed, nothing lower than `bottom` (Mark is 2 m tall: 217); draws the real cables: each speaker's leads down and along the wall to behind the TV, and the bundle from under the TV to a triple outlet. Origin back-centre on the floor under the TV's centre.
